perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.description: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.description: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.description: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.
